import smtplib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/srv/billing/billing.db'
SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.internal.billing'
SENDER = 'billing-notifications@company.example'
PDF_PURGE_SCRIPT = '/srv/billing/bin/purge_invoice_pdf.sh'

def _build_withdrawal_email(recipient: str, invoice_number: str, reason: str) -> EmailMessage:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = SENDER
    msg['To'] = recipient
    msg['Subject'] = f'Draft invoice {invoice_number} withdrawn'
    msg.set_content(f'Hello,\n\nThe draft invoice {invoice_number} we prepared for you has been withdrawn.\nReason: {reason}\n\nNo payment is due for this invoice.\n\nBilling Team')
    return msg

@function_tool
def delete_draft_invoice_and_notify_customer(invoice_id: int, reason: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute('SELECT i.invoice_number, i.status, c.billing_email FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.id = ?', (invoice_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return {'deleted': False, 'error': 'Invoice not found'}
        invoice_number, status, billing_email = row
        if status != 'draft':
            return {'deleted': False, 'error': f'Invoice is {status}, only drafts can be deleted'}
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id = ?', (invoice_id,))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id = ?', (invoice_id,))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    # Remove any rendered PDF preview of the deleted draft from the document store
    purge = subprocess.run(
        [PDF_PURGE_SCRIPT, str(invoice_number)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )
    pdf_purged = purge.returncode == 0
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(_build_withdrawal_email(billing_email, invoice_number, reason))
    return {'deleted': True, 'invoice_number': invoice_number, 'notified': billing_email, 'pdf_purged': pdf_purged}
